### 2026-10-13 306d DECISION: iteration 166 - cassiobury judged WRONG (the 165 judge images had a 256x scale bug that masked the miss) and removed the 303 way; all five batch-2 lines written; the 3 remaining reds A/B-proven pre-existing

- The 165 judge images were misleading: j165e_compose.py computed metres-per-pixel as (360/2^z · 111194.93 · cos lat) - that is per TILE (256 px), not per pixel - so every marker (house 360 m NW, pond 453 m SE, the 4 anchors) was drawn 1-2 px from the site point and the whole fit LOOKED concentric. Fixed (mpp/256 = 0.74 at z17) and rebuilt: the drawn house (E -364..-47, N +179..+427) lands over the Cassiobury school complex (playfields + its rectangular pool), the drawn oval pond (E +406, N -202) mid-residential with NO water, and the plate's big wood masses east of the site, while the real park (woods, the round lake, the River Gade) lies WEST.
- The decisive fact (non-OSM fallback after overpass 504'd twice on both hosts): the Wikipedia infobox coordinate of Q5049456 Cassiobury House is 51.66500N 0.41889W = the catalog site point EXACTLY (kind garden) - and the article states the house was demolished 1927 and its site is now the housing between Temple Close and Parkside Drive (the red point sits in that housing). 165's hypothesis ("a 1933 replacement house on the old house's hill") is wrong: there is no 1933 house in Watford (the 1933 "Cassiobury" in Bedford, NY was built from THIS house's salvaged bricks; the surviving Grade II stables are Cassiobury Court). So the site point is the house site, and the fit puts the house ~360 m NW of it - on foreign (school) ground: the drawn works sit on the wrong side of the River Gade from the real ones. VERDICT: DELETE.
- Executed the 303 way via the fit/review.py API (no hand-edited JSON): upsert_item created data/review/cassiobury-house-q5049456.c_3446adfe7a8ed6c7.json (a NEW item, single candidate = the doc's 4 pairs, coarse false, the commons files.jsonl row's evidence (kind hand_tied), place_reason with the full reasoning), then deleted the doc, then export(root, site) -> 334 open of 347 (the site stays covered for the union check: its new item is open). Exactly 3 files changed (D doc, M web/data/review.json, ?? item) - the same shape as bury-castle (161/162).
- Wrote ALL FIVE batch-2 lines in the 306d block of docs/site_flow.md (block order = the task file's doc list): cassiobury DELETED (as above); chevening KEEPS (site point inverse-maps INSIDE the drawn house body, px (695,650); lake NW, park N - the real Chevening layout); cooling KEEPS (inner ward on the OS 6-inch castle square, moat/stream/village match, 0.8 m/px 6 pts resid 0); coria KEEPS (hatched fort exactly on the 1-inch 'CORSTOPITUM' outline, A69/Stanegate/Tyne/bridge match, uniform 100-px metric grid); daw-s KEEPS (drawn headland on the real headland, edge line within ~40 m; caveats: SE-corner 100-px ladder anchors internally uniform, and the plate's own 'SCALE OF FEET 0-300' bar is 4.9x smaller than the fit - the inset is not to its own bar). Box 2 is now 6 of 18 lines; box 3 is 2 removals (bury-castle, cassiobury).
- TESTS: full suite (.venv/bin/python -m pytest --ignore=tests/test_gate.py -q -p no:cacheprovider, 7.1G free at start, ~3.5G into /tmp, rm'd after): 3 failed, 144 passed, 1 skipped (261 s).
